newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Zeus jumps 16.82 pct on takeover rumour.
newsitem.headline: Zeus jumps 16.82 pct on takeover rumour.

text.p: Shares of Zeus Holdings Inc jumped 16.82 percent to 2.50 pesos by midsession on Monday on the Philippine Stock Exchange on takeover rumours, brokers said.
Brokers said some investors were buying the stock on rumours that a foreign company was planning to gain control of the company. Zeus Holdings officials were not immediately available to comment.
A total of 602,000 shares were traded.
Zeus recently converted itself into a holding company. It was formerly called JR Garments which ceased to operate on August 30.
